description.value:
This bleeding-edge runic mesh absorbs and redirects the fundamental energies of life and death.

Activate—Absorb r (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You would take damage from or be healed by a vitality or void effect

Effect You gain resistance to the triggering damage equal to four times your level or reduce the number of Hit Points you regain by the same amount.

Activate—Redirect 1 to 3 (manipulate)

Requirements You've used the Absorb reaction since the end of your last turn

Effect You invert and redirect the absorbed energy. You cast a 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Harm] or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Heal] spell with the same number of actions you spent on the activation. If you absorbed a void effect, you cast heal, and if you absorbed a vitality effect, you cast harm.
